Maize hybrids in six environments (multi-environment trial)

Source: R/breeding.R
maize_met.Rd

Simulated yields of 12 maize hybrids in six environments, each a randomised complete block design with three blocks; the interaction has a multiplicative structure of rank two plus noise.

Usage

maize_met

Format

A data frame with 216 rows and 4 columns:

Environment

Environment (E1-E6).

Block

Block within environment (1-3).

Hybrid

Hybrid (H01-H12).

Yield_t_ha

Grain yield, t/ha.

Examples

ammi(maize_met, "Yield_t_ha", "Hybrid", "Environment", block = "Block")
